title: Hot reload leaves a blank display: createStartUpPageContainer returns 1
claim: The Your First App page says that after editing main.ts, Vite hot-reloads and the simulator refreshes, and that hot reload also works on the glasses. The Page Lifecycle page says createStartUpPageContainer is called exactly once at startup.
actual: A hot reload runs main.ts again in the same app launch. createStartUpPageContainer then returns 1 (invalid parameters) every time, also on ten retries 250 ms apart, because a page already exists. The display goes blank or keeps a stale frame, and nothing shows the error. A fresh simulator launch returns 0. rebuildPageContainer returns true on some reloads and false on others. On hardware, a second call in the same launch blocked about 2.1 s and returned 1.
impact: A developer following the quickstart sees a frozen or blank display after the first edit and takes it for an event bug.
workaround: Relaunch the simulator or the app after each edit, or call rebuildPageContainer when createStartUpPageContainer returns 1 and check that result too.

evidence.note: On hardware, as a recovery attempt after the exit dialog, not after a hot reload. Concludes the call is one-shot per session.

createStartUpPageContainer returned 0 on the first call and 1 on a second call in the same load and after each of 10 reloads. rebuildPageContainer returned true after all 10 reloads; the intermittent false in the report was not seen.
Same as on 0.0.16, rebuildPageContainer true after all 10 reloads.
